notes.title: Demo Update 01
notes.notes:
We Updated the Demo!
A bit delayed, but we published the first update for the demo today! 

It's a small download (roughly 150mb). 

Here's what's changed:

Cut the amount of battery drained per second while using the flashlight in half. 

Fixed issue where the Pause menu didn't function properly after interacting with the workbench

Added QoL tips for using interior lights when possible and that it's currently expected for the wheel to freeze during the loading screen.

These changes were made based upon player feedback. Do keep the feedback coming! We'll continue to adjust the demo based upon your experiences and it'll also help us make the full game even better.
We appreciate you.Tell your friends about the game. We need your help getting the word out!
Immortal, Inc.

(Justin)
